services.name: Education Programs
services.desc: From field trips to summer camps, Kidzeum connects classroom learning to real-world discovery. We partner with schools and community organizations to make science accessible to every child. Kidzeum’s education programs meet learners where they are: Learning Labs for school groups, hands-on camps and classes at the museum, and outreach programs that bring STEAM learning directly into schools and the community. Full-day themed camps for grades K-3, with hands-on science, engineering, creativity, and museum exploration built into each week.
